app = modal.App("image-to-video",image=image)

MODEL_PATH = Path("/models")
model_volume = modal.Volume.from_name("ltx2-model",create_if_missing=True)

@app.cls(gpu="B200",volumes={MODEL_PATH:model_volume},timeout=600,scaledown_window=300)
class Model:
    @modal.enter()
    def load_model(self):
        import torch
        from diffusers import LTX2ImageToVideoPipeline
        self.pipe = LTX2ImageToVideoPipeline.from_pretrained("Lightricks/LTX-2",torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16)
        self.pipe.to("cuda")
        model_volume.commit()
    
    @modal.method()
    def generate_video(self,image_bytes:bytes):
        import torch
        from PIL import Image
        from diffusers.pipelines.ltx2.export_utils import encode_video
        image = Image.open(io.BytesIO(image_bytes)).convert("RGB")
        prompt = "The scene comes to life with natural movement and realistic motion"
        negative_prompt = "worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted"
        video_frames,audio = self.pipe(image=image,prompt=prompt,negative_prompt=negative_prompt,width=768,height=512,num_frames=121,num_inference_steps=30,guidance_scale=3.0,frame_rate=24.0)
        output_buffer = io.BytesIO()
        encode_video(video_frames,audio,fps=24.0,output_path=output_buffer)
        output_buffer.seek(0)
        return output_buffer.read()

@app.function()
@modal.asgi_app()
def fastapi_app():
    from fastapi import FastAPI,File,UploadFile,Form
    from fastapi.responses import Response
    import asyncio
    web_app = FastAPI()
    
    @web_app.post("/generate")
    async def generate_endpoint(file:UploadFile=File(...),prompt:str=Form(None)):
        image_data = await file.read()
        model = Model()
        video_bytes = model.generate_video.remote(image_data)
        return Response(content=video_bytes,media_type="video/mp4")
    
    return web_app

import modal
import io
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

image = modal.Image.debian_slim(python_version="3.12").apt_install("ffmpeg").pip_install("torch==2.7.0","torchvision","diffusers==0.33.1","transformers==4.51.3","accelerate==1.6.0","sentencepiece==0.2.0","protobuf","huggingface-hub==0.36.0","fastapi","python-multipart","Pillow","imageio==2.37.0","imageio-ffmpeg==0.5.1","numpy").env({"HF_HOME":"/models"})

app = modal.App("image-to-video",image=image)

MODEL_PATH = Path("/models")
model_volume = modal.Volume.from_name("ltx2-model-cache",create_if_missing=True)

@app.cls(gpu="B200",volumes={MODEL_PATH:model_volume},timeout=3600,scaledown_window=300,container_idle_timeout=600)
class Model:
    @modal.enter()
    def load_model(self):
        import torch
        from diffusers import LTX2ImageToVideoPipeline
        self.pipe = LTX2ImageToVideoPipeline.from_pretrained("Lightricks/LTX-2",torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,cache_dir="/models")
        self.pipe.to("cuda")
        model_volume.commit()
    
    @modal.method()
    def generate_video(self,image_bytes:bytes,prompt:str,negative_prompt:str,width:int,height:int,num_frames:int,num_inference_steps:int,guidance_scale:float,frame_rate:float):
        import torch
        import numpy as np
        from PIL import Image
        from diffusers.pipelines.ltx2.export_utils import encode_video
        image = Image.open(io.BytesIO(image_bytes)).convert("RGB")
        video,audio = self.pipe(image=image,prompt=prompt,negative_prompt=negative_prompt,width=width,height=height,num_frames=num_frames,frame_rate=frame_rate,num_inference_steps=num_inference_steps,guidance_scale=guidance_scale,output_type="np",return_dict=False)
        video = (video * 255).round().astype("uint8")
        video = torch.from_numpy(video)
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp4",delete=False) as tmp_file:
            tmp_path = tmp_file.name
        encode_video(video[0],fps=frame_rate,audio=audio[0].float().cpu(),audio_sample_rate=self.pipe.vocoder.config.output_sampling_rate,output_path=tmp_path)
        with open(tmp_path,"rb") as f:
            video_bytes = f.read()
        import os
        os.unlink(tmp_path)
        return video_bytes

@app.function()
@modal.asgi_app()
def fastapi_app():
    from fastapi import FastAPI,File,UploadFile,Form,HTTPException
    from fastapi.responses import Response
    web_app = FastAPI()
    
    @web_app.post("/generate")
    async def generate_endpoint(file:UploadFile=File(...),prompt:str=Form("The scene comes to life with natural movement and realistic motion"),negative_prompt:str=Form("worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted"),width:int=Form(768),height:int=Form(512),num_frames:int=Form(121),num_inference_steps:int=Form(40),guidance_scale:float=Form(4.0),frame_rate:float=Form(24.0)):
        if file.content_type not in ["image/jpeg","image/jpg","image/png"]:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400,detail="Invalid file type. Only JPEG and PNG images are supported.")
        if width % 32 != 0 or height % 32 != 0:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400,detail="Width and height must be divisible by 32.")
        image_data = await file.read()
        model = Model()
        video_bytes = model.generate_video.remote(image_data,prompt,negative_prompt,width,height,num_frames,num_inference_steps,guidance_scale,frame_rate)
        return Response(content=video_bytes,media_type="video/mp4",headers={"Content-Disposition":"attachment; filename=generated_video.mp4"})
    
    @web_app.get("/")
    async def root():
        return {"status":"LTX-2 Image-to-Video API is running","model":"Lightricks/LTX-2","gpu":"NVIDIA B200","endpoints":{"/generate":"POST - Upload image and generate video","/health":"GET - Health check"}}
    
    @web_app.get("/health")
    async def health():
        return {"status":"healthy"}
    
    return web_app
